notes: Footprint = cohdrop layer (coherence loss, already filtered by build_event.change_footprint). INGV publishes the flow extent as PDF maps only, so patches are boxes and circles at named landmarks. The pair ends 16 Aug, before the 16-19 Aug advance. The ~-7 cm LOS over the Valle del Bove is within the quiet baseline pair's 8 cm range, so no fact interprets it as motion. INGV's GNSS deflation from 8 Aug has no published size; NISAR shows none beyond noise, and the fact says so.

facts.title: Fresh lava buried ~2.4 km² of the upper flank
facts.text: Between 1,800 and 3,000 m, in the Valle del Leone and the upper Valle del Bove, NISAR's coherence collapsed over about 2.4 km² where August's lava covered the ground. INGV measured a final lava field of about 2 km² and 8-11 million m³.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | INGV-OE weekly bulletins (18 and 25 Aug 2026) https://www.ct.ingv.it/index.php/monitoraggio-e-sorveglianza/prodotti-del-monitoraggio/bollettini-settimanali-multidisciplinari

facts.title: A new vent at Monte Rittmann shed small pyroclastic flows
facts.text: On 8 August a new vent opened at about 2,300 m near Monte Rittmann, on a steep slope; part of its cone collapsed into the new lava. Within 600 m NISAR lost coherence over about 0.56 km².

facts.title: Lava fronts at Rocca Capra: below what NISAR resolves
facts.text: The lava reached about 1,340-1,370 m around the Rocca Capra ridge by 11-13 August, burning broom and pine. NISAR shows no coherence-loss footprint here: the lower flow is narrow, and this ground matched itself poorly even before the eruption.

facts.title: Zafferana Etnea got ash, not lava
facts.text: No inhabited town was reached by lava. Zafferana Etnea, on the lower east flank, got ash fall and airport disruption. NISAR sees coherent, still ground here (about -0.3 cm).

facts.title: The summit deflated, but too little for NISAR to see
facts.text: INGV's GNSS network showed a clear deflation of the volcano from 8 August, without giving its size. Within 3 km of the summit NISAR reads about -1 cm (-4 to +1 cm), well inside the 8 cm spread of the quiet pair before the eruption, so it shows no clear deflation.
